lines.en: I run on four legs
The bandana around my neck flutters
I run low to the ground

lines.zh: 我这双耳朵，一只听草，一只听你。
lines.en: One ear hears the grass, one ear hears you.
I run across a patch of grass
I stop and sniff

lines.zh: 我走路时，尾巴在前头晃。
lines.en: As I walk, my tail sways ahead.
I run a circle around my companion
I walk on through the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我从两棵树之间穿过去
lines.en: I dart between two trees
I run light and fast
I head toward the voices
I crouch on the ground
My ears keep moving
My ears turn toward birdsong.

lines.zh: 这条头巾是别人给我的
lines.en: Someone gave me this bandana
I still remember being newly hatched
I wag my tail slowly
My nose is to the ground
My tail sweeps the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 我在等一个命令，耳朵一直动着。
lines.en: I wait for an order, ears moving.
My paws scratch the dirt
Too many smells mixed together here.
I look up at the sky
I sniff the earth at the roots.

lines.zh: 我在等有人叫我的名字
lines.en: I wait for someone to call my name
My name is Bowmon

lines.zh: 草甸上，我闻到你身上有别的东西。
lines.en: On the meadow, I smell something else on you.

lines.zh: 我围着你跑了两个来回。
lines.en: I run two circles around you.
What are you looking for in this wood
I follow people
Are you raising your hand to call me
My teeth are small, but quick
You may pat my head
I am a little curious about you

lines.zh: 你要是一直走，我就跟着
lines.en: If you keep walking, I will follow
My ears catch your heartbeat
Do not move suddenly
I stay by your feet
Can you keep up if I run
I remember paths well

lines.zh: 我一直看你腰上的口袋。
lines.en: I keep eyeing the pouch at your belt.
I yelp and back off
My fur got pulled
My ears flatten back.
I circle off and reset

lines.zh: 九格的幼体，进化是弓兽。
lines.en: A nine-block baby, evolving to Bowmon.
I cannot take many hits
My ears flattened
I back into the grass
I tuck my tail and dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 我贴地跑，头巾在脖子上飘。
lines.en: I run low, my scarf streaming at my neck.
My nose caught food
I touch my nose to your knuckles.
Let me have a sniff
Hold it still
I will jump and take a bite
That smell suits my taste
I do not eat slowly
On the ground is fine
After this I will run with you
My tail is wagging already
I can take it in one bite
I will wag my tail after eating
You stepped on my tail tip
I yelped and jumped aside
My reaction is a bit faster
That rocked me
I back off and reset
My fur rubs your trouser leg.
Your legs are far longer than mine
Pressed this close, I step away
I shake the sand from my fur
I will remember that leg
I am young, that comes later
There are others of us in the wood
Two running together go fast
They run steadier than I do

lines.zh: 我们一起追过一只虫子
lines.en: We chased a bug together once
Neither of us falls behind
This is our route
When danger comes we both bark
Tomorrow we will be on this slope
A few more in the pack is livelier
I bury it in the grass.
This does not taste good
My little paws pin it down.
I buried it
I pick up whatever falls
I carried it a stretch
My mouth is open, but I cannot bite yet.

lines.zh: 我叼着它把尾巴摇成风。
lines.en: I carry it over, tail whipping like wind.
Little bubbles are all I can spit.
I dug a hole and hid it
Something moved

lines.zh: 耳朵竖起来，有东西在动。
lines.en: Ears up — something is moving.
A Baby II stage watching you too.
That thing is not small
I crouch, ready to dash
I am ready to run
I crouch low, fur bristling.
My paw prints are on this slope
I will bark once for it
The wind carries its smell
Let me circle it halfway
My nose twitches.
My tail traces a circle.
I move along the grass
It cannot turn as fast as I can
I wait for it to leave an opening

lines.zh: 我伏着身子在林子里跑。
lines.en: I run through the trees, body low.
It is bigger, but I am faster
I try cutting in from the side
I dare not get too close
It is getting impatient
The chance is coming

lines.zh: 我像只小狗，可我是数码兽。
lines.en: I look like a pup, but I'm a Digimon.
I wait for it to turn its back
I lock my teeth on its tail.
That bite was quick

lines.zh: 我的爪子一下就过去了
lines.en: My paw went in fast
I leap in and swipe.
I retreat, ears still up.
My strength is not yet great
That bite hurt it
I circle at its feet
I am panting
I pull back to try again

lines.zh: 我又咬了一口，泡泡还在嘴里。
lines.en: I bit again; bubbles still in my mouth.
My teeth are not large
I shake the shell bits off my fur.
The bandana is still around my neck
I find my footing in the forest
All the smells here are new
I run two steps to test my legs
I head toward the trees
The wind is strong on the meadow
I scratch the dirt twice first
I sniff the ground first
I am ready to follow someone
I shake the dirt off
I ran a lap first
Fire caught my fur and I jumped away

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，爪子刮着土
lines.en: I roll down the slope, claws scraping
The water is too deep, I cannot climb out
The blast flung me aside

lines.zh: 飞来的东西擦过我的肋
lines.en: Something flying grazed my ribs
That force pressed me to the ground
Hunger stops me running

lines.zh: 雷声吓得我钻进了树洞。
lines.en: The thunder drives me into a hollow.
There is no ground to run on in the void
